snippets.HORSE_QUEST_HORSEY_01: Hello! My name is Mister Horsey! I have travelled a long way to get to Panfu so that I can get to know the horses that live here.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_HORSEY_02: Shasan is the name of the breed. These horses have been living in Panfu for quite some time, yet no one has been able to tame or ride them. But I have a feeling this will change soon.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_HORSEY_03: I'm specialized in training the Shasan breed and have studied them for many years. I'll teach you what I know so that you'll be able to ride them.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_HORSEY_04: First, you'll have to convince the horse that you like him. To do that, you'll have to feed him a special type of horse feed. The main ingredient is the rare Baya plant.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_HORSEY_05: I think that this plant grows in the jungle. In any case, a plant of this sort requires lots of water. I noticed that you have a couple of water bombs with you. You might have to water the plant a bit before you're able to pick the fruit.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_HORSEY_06: Go to the jungle and pick a fruit off of the Baya plant. You'll have to water the plant before it'll be able to bear fruit.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_HORSEY_07: Great! You've got a piece of the fruit! Feed it to the horse here in the stall.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_HORSEY_08: You've fed the horse. Now you'll need a saddle. Go speak to the guy that specializes in saddle-making. He'll be able to help you.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_SADDLER_01: Speak to the horse trainer, Mister Horsey. You'll find him in the horse stall.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_SADDLER_02: Hello! You say you need a saddle for a Shasan horse? Now that's a difficult business!
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_SADDLER_03: You must bring me three pieces. Out of them I'll be able to make a saddle for you. You can find the first piece at the pet store.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_SADDLER_04: Super, you've found a piece of the saddle. Go to the changing room at the pool and look for the next piece.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_SADDLER_05: Great! You've found a piece of the saddle. Go to the library and look for the next piece.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_SADDLER_06: Well, isn't that something? You've found all the parts. Give me a day to work on your saddle and get it ready for you. Come back tomorrow.
snippets.HORSE_QUEST_SADDLER_07: Here's your saddle! Go to the horse stall and try it out. You'll be able to ride the horse now. Unfortunately, only Gold Pandas are able to ride the horses, but all Pandas will receive a new background for their player's card. Go take a look!
